meta.windowNote: The most recent 766 trading days of daily simple returns, as docs/PRD.md registers for the covariance window. One row per trading day: the date, then one return per ticker in the order of the tickers list.
meta.pricesNote: Live prices, unofficial educational data. These are NOT the frozen research snapshot: data/prices.json and the verdicts in data/results.json are unchanged by this file and enter no verdict here.
meta.noTimestampNote: Deliberately no generated-at field: the refresh workflow commits this file only when it changed, and a timestamp would make every run look like fresh data. The commit dates it.
